item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I have come here after a tweet from Doctor Cimmerian.

It is a good piece and I cannot really find flaws in it, but for some reason it doesn't resonate with me. It has a lot of good: a personal struggle, problems with amnestics, a flaw in the MCD plan and a flaw in "not being seen by the Foundation". The punchline is ironic and great.

But I feel nothing for the main character. I don't understand the point about flying, my parents had a fine marriage so I cannot sympathize with the main character on that front. And after the divorce it is all (or almost all) his fault.

Once again - the tale is very good, but I don't like it, so I novote it. But it sure to be successful.

Don McLean reference

Instant +1 from me.

Seriously though this was pretty great. Hard for me to put into words why, but I enjoyed this a lot. Godspeed, Cimmerian. Godspeed.
I've always loved 055 explanation pieces, and here's one that made me feel genuine emotions. Flight was a nice thematic tie in, too.
